task: Find the most recent article on BBC News about archaeological discoveries and summarize the main findings and their significance.
answer: Most recent BBC News archaeology article: 'Roman ruins found at school could add £1m to repair bill' (published 2 days ago, https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cqlyej9znzn4o). Main findings: Archaeologists carrying out a dig at Caerleon Comprehensive School in south Wales, ahead of refurbishment works, discovered Roman remains thought to include a parade ground and a road, part of the legionary fortress complex of the Second Augustan Legion. Significance: The discovery has paused the school's refurbishment project and could add around £1m to its repair bill, while also underscoring Caerleon's importance as one of Britain's best-preserved Roman legionary sites; the finds may reshape plans for the school and add to understanding of Roman military life in Wales.
